selected_companion_blocks: SUPPLY-CHAIN-AND-RELEASE.md#Untrusted code in a privileged workflow

local_checks.invariant: Production deploy credentials must only be consumed by trusted immutable actions and must not be retained on the host.
local_checks.result: deploy.yml:113 uses appleboy/ssh-action@v1.2.2 (mutable tag) with EC2_SSH_KEY and :124 embeds EC2_GIT_TOKEN into the remote git URL; deploy runs on push to main with no environment protection; sync job holds long-lived AWS keys.

unresolved: Branch-protection rules, GitHub environment protection and the scope/expiry of EC2_GIT_TOKEN are hosted-state facts that are not source-visible.

local_checks.invariant: Production schema must change only via reviewed migrations; the internet-facing workload must not run as root with host rw access.
local_checks.result: entrypoint.sh:24 runs `npx prisma db push --skip-generate` in the startup loop (always, via .env.prod DATABASE_URL); Dockerfile has no USER (root), supervisord.conf:3 user=root, and docker-compose.prod.yml:52 bind-mounts the host repo rw at .:/app plus /etc/letsencrypt.

unresolved: Impact of db push depends on live schema drift, not observable from source.

local_checks.invariant: No real credential is committed, and every secret-bearing runtime config path is excluded from version control.
local_checks.result: History contains only placeholders (PASS on committed secrets), BUT .gitignore:34 ignores .env/.env.local/*.local/*.pem/*.key and does not match .env.prod/.env.production, while docs/01-despliegue/despliegue.md:81 and docker-compose.prod.yml:41 require .env.prod with real DB_PASSWORD/JWT_SECRET in the working tree.

unresolved: Whether a populated .env.prod was committed on a remote branch cannot be verified without contacting the remote.

local_checks.invariant: A caller-supplied body must not be relayed verbatim to a privileged downstream service under a server-side key.
local_checks.result: middleware.ts:29 requires only auspicios:view; grabar/route.ts:9-18 checks session then posts JSON.stringify(body) unmodified to ${KBS_URL}/rest/saveauspicio with x-api-key KBSERVICIOS_API_KEY; listar constrains code/codeEvent, showing a disparity.

unresolved: The downstream saveauspicio contract (which injected fields change privileged state) is not in the repository.

local_checks.invariant: A profile self-update must bind its write to a server-side allowlist; identity/credential/authorization columns must never reach the ORM update.
local_checks.result: auth.controller.ts:64 assigns await request.json() to PerfilUpdateRequestDTO as a compile-time cast with no Zod parse; auth-service.ts:91 forwards it; auth-repository.ts:57 runs prisma.userRole.updateMany({where:{email:session.email}, data}) with that object. The generated UserRoleUncheckedUpdateManyInput admits id/userId/roleId/email/password/resetToken/resetTokenExpires, so extra keys are written.

local_checks.invariant: Passwords must be verified against a salted one-way hash, never stored/compared in plaintext.
local_checks.result: auth-service.ts:23 compares userRoles[0].password !== dto.password against a plaintext column; auth-repository.ts:8 selects the cleartext password; schema.prisma:125 defaults it to '123456'; role-repository.ts:20 creates accounts with no password; seed.ts:36-49 seeds known plaintext passwords. No bcrypt/argon2/scrypt/timingSafeEqual exists in src.

local_checks.invariant: Recovery tokens must come from a CSPRNG, be single-use, expiring, and bound to the account.
local_checks.result: auth-service.ts:99 builds the token from Math.random(); auth-repository.ts:71-76 accepts token+expiry and :78-80 clears on use (single-use); auth-service.ts:102 places it in a URL query string mailed via email.ts.

local_checks.invariant: JWT signing/verification must pin a strong key source and bind issuer/audience; session minting must not escalate body claims.
local_checks.result: auth.ts:9 falls back to 'dev-secret-cambiar-en-produccion' and auth-service.ts:53 to 'dev-secret'; seleccionar-evento jwtVerify at :54 omits iss/aud (unlike verifyToken auth.ts:46); :67-74 re-signs a 24h token with body eventoId/tipoEvento/codigoEvento; auth.controller.ts:52 writes the cookie without Secure.

unresolved: Deployed JWT_SECRET value is not source-visible; .env.prod.example:29 ships it empty and Dockerfile.ecs:37 bakes only a build-time placeholder, so the hardcoded fallback may be the live signing key.

local_checks.invariant: PII lookup must require a permission binding the caller to the resource.
local_checks.result: middleware.ts:30 registers /api/entidades with no permission, so any authenticated role passes; entidades.controller.ts:7-18 forwards attacker documento/nombre to upstream searchpersonv00 and returns full PII DTO (entidades.dto.ts:13-46) with no scope or rate limit.

local_checks.invariant: An unauthenticated append-only store must bound per-record size and total cardinality/retention.
local_checks.result: No PROTECTED prefix matches /api/errors; route.ts:7-32 accepts attacker message/stack/digest/url/metadata with optional userId; error-logger.ts:16 creates ErrorLog with no length cap, dedup, rate limit, or retention; schema.prisma:397-409 has unbounded String/Json columns.

local_checks.invariant: The exhibitor directory exposed to a lower-trust reader must be limited to the contract's data class/scope.

unresolved: Whether any deployed non-admin role holds facturacion:view is a database/deployment fact.

unresolved: Whether a deployed non-admin role holds facturacion:view is a database/deployment fact.

unresolved: Niubiz proxy HTTP-status vs body success semantics are provider-side and not source-visible.
Whether a deployment has a non-admin role holding facturacion:view is a data fact.

unresolved: Whether a deployed non-admin role holds facturacion:view is a database/deployment fact.

local_checks.invariant: A protected stand-inventory read must be authenticated/authorized by the gate and bound to the caller's scope.

local_checks.invariant: A record update must bind the target to the caller and require the right permission.

local_checks.invariant: A demo generator must require privileged authorization and must not downgrade live state.
local_checks.result: /api/gess/mockup is unprotected and gessController.mockup has no check (gess.controller.ts:50-59); gess-service.ts:106 resolves planos from caller codes and :124-145 upserts forcing estado 'disponible' (:132) and empresa null (:133).

local_checks.invariant: A bulk import must enforce authentication, authority, and event binding.

local_checks.invariant: An internal integration proxy must require an authenticated/authorized principal.
local_checks.result: /api/kbservicios matches no PROTECTED/public entry (middleware.ts:72 allows); kbservicios.controller.ts:9-13 reads body.code and calls services.kbServicios.listarEventos with no session check, unlike the sibling auspicios proxy which calls getSession (route.ts:9-10).

unresolved: The legacy response data class and deployed network/credential authorization are outside the repository.

local_checks.invariant: No attacker-controlled path/URL or unbounded fan-out may reach a sink.
local_checks.result: The route takes only numeric type/event codes and performs one POST to the fixed env PLANOGESS_API_URL (planogess-client.ts:26-41) with a depth-limited parser; no traversal/SSRF/deserialization/fan-out is source-establishable. TLS toggle is owned by the separate kbservicios/planogess TLS unit.

hardening_notes: Anonymous reachability + upstream quota cost is not source-establishable; recorded as hardening.

local_checks.invariant: Values interpolated into generated TypeScript source must be escaped or typed so stored fields cannot break out of literals/keys.

local_checks.invariant: Imported layout values must satisfy the same charset/length/type constraints as create/layout before persistence and code emission.

unresolved: Whether any in-repo caller feeds importar output directly into a build step is not source-visible.

local_checks.invariant: Only authorized principals may write files, and stored bytes must not be served as executable same-origin content.
local_checks.result: No PROTECTED entry matches /api/upload and it is not in PUBLIC lists, so middleware.ts:72 lets it through anonymously; route.ts:17 derives the extension from file.name with no allowlist; storage.ts:15 writes to public/uploads; nginx.conf:26 serves /uploads/ with extension-inferred content type and no nosniff/attachment.

local_checks.invariant: A stored documentos/imagenes URL rendered into an anchor href must not reach an executable URL scheme.
local_checks.result: gess.validator.ts:6 and reserva.validator.ts:5 accept documentos as arbitrary strings rendered as <a href={url} target=_blank> (plano-dinamico.tsx:649 etc.), but React 19.2.4's built-in sanitizer rewrites javascript: href/src to a throwing URL (react-dom-client.production.js:1412-1414,12989-13005); data: top-level navigation is browser-blocked and target=_blank implies noopener. No executable sink remains; missing scheme allowlist is hardening.

hardening_notes: Rejected candidate components.plano.documentos.unvalidated-scheme-to-href: React sanitizer is the source-verified preventing layer. Residual hardening: add an http/https allowlist and rel=noopener noreferrer.

local_checks.invariant: Outbound TLS clients must verify the peer certificate; policy must be per-connection, not a process-global env toggle.
local_checks.result: kbservicios-client.ts:7 sets process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED='0' before fetch and :14 resets to '1'; planogess-client.ts:27/34 repeat. Both clients are singletons (services.ts), so verification is disabled process-wide during the window and any early rejection leaves it disabled.

local_checks.invariant: A workload identity must be scoped to the resources and operations it needs.
local_checks.result: S3 is scoped to the docs bucket ARN and Secrets Manager to values(var.secret_arns) (secrets/main.tf:208-223, ecs/main.tf:419-428).
